Install typora on Omarchy

Typora merges the writing and preview panes into one live document: type an asterisk for bold or a hash for a heading and it renders instantly, with no separate preview window and no visible syntax clutter. It handles tables, code blocks, math, diagrams, and images inline, and can export a finished document to PDF, Word, LaTeX, EPUB, and other formats. Outline navigation, focus/typewriter modes, and CSS-based theming round it out for long-form writing.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add typora
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.14.9-2:
    pacman -Qi typora

Open and use typora

typora is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql typora | grep applications

Frequently asked questions

How do I install typora on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add typora. The download is 136.5 MB and it takes 369.8 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is typora free?

$14.99 one-time, licensed for up to 3 devices; 15-day free trial. The package is licensed custom:"Copyright (c) 2015 Abner Lee All Rights Reserved.".

How do I uninstall typora?

Run omarchy pkg drop typora. It removes the package from your system.

What does typora depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: gtk3, nss, alsa-lib. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is typora a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for typora.

Is typora in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as typora (version 1.14.9-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Typora makes it. Project site: https://typora.io/.
